# genesyscloud_architect_ivr_identity_resolution (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud architect IVR identity resolution settings. Destroy restores the IVR to its default identity resolution configuration (resolve_identities = true, unassigned division).

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/architect/ivrs/{ivrId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-architect-ivrs--ivrId-)
* [GET /api/v2/architect/ivrs/{ivrId}/identityresolution](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-architect-ivrs--ivrId--identityresolution)
* [PUT /api/v2/architect/ivrs/{ivrId}/identityresolution](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#put-api-v2-architect-ivrs--ivrId--identityresolution)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `routing:callRoute:edit`
* `routing:callRoute:view`
* `routing:identityResolutionIvr:edit`
* `routing:identityResolutionIvr:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `architect`
* `architect:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_architect_ivr_identity_resolution" "example_ivr_identity_resolution" {
  ivr_id             = genesyscloud_architect_ivr.sample_ivr.id
  resolve_identities = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ivr_id` (String) ID of the architect IVR this identity resolution config belongs to.
- `resolve_identities` (Boolean) Whether identities should be resolved.

### Optional

- `division_id` (String) The division to use when performing identity resolution. If not set, * means the unassigned (star) division. '*' may also be set explicitly for the same behavior.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
